g.text: 7. System Wiring Contract & Safety Rules (SSOT: hardware/wiring_contract.py)

g.desc: 7. System Wiring Contract & Safety Rules (SSOT: hardware/wiring_contract.py)

g.text: - Strictly Excluded: ZERO Fan, ZERO AC Mains, ZERO IR Blaster anywhere in schematic, PCB, firmware, or docs.

g.desc: - Strictly Excluded: ZERO Fan, ZERO AC Mains, ZERO IR Blaster anywhere in schematic, PCB, firmware, or docs.

g.text: - Voltage Safety: Soil LM393 (J14) & KY-037 (J15) & DHT11 (J13) strictly +3.3V; SG90/Relays/Pump/PAM8403 on +5V rail.

g.desc: - Voltage Safety: Soil LM393 (J14) & KY-037 (J15) & DHT11 (J13) strictly +3.3V; SG90/Relays/Pump/PAM8403 on +5V rail.

g.text: - Unused Pins Marked NC (ERC=0): Relay 1 NC, Relay 2 NC, Soil LM393 DO, KY-037 AO.

g.desc: - Unused Pins Marked NC (ERC=0): Relay 1 NC, Relay 2 NC, Soil LM393 DO, KY-037 AO.

g.text: - Harness Totals: 15 Hub Connectors (J1..J15 = 36 pins) + 4 Inter-Module Wires (PAM8403->Spk, LM393->YL-69) = 40 Wires (W01..W40).

g.desc: - Harness Totals: 15 Hub Connectors (J1..J15 = 36 pins) + 4 Inter-Module Wires (PAM8403->Spk, LM393->YL-69) = 40 Wires (W01..W40).

g.text: - Locked Hardware Scope: 6 Actuators (SG90 D1, Living LED D0, Bedroom LED D4, Pump/RLY1 D6, Buzzer D8, Amp/RLY2 D7+D3) + 3 Sensors.

g.desc: - Locked Hardware Scope: 6 Actuators (SG90 D1, Living LED D0, Bedroom LED D4, Pump/RLY1 D6, Buzzer D8, Amp/RLY2 D7+D3) + 3 Sensors.
